Metadata.label: GiftDesignation
Metadata._archive_note: Full DPE payload retrieved from a Fundraising Cloud org. Complete JSON pasted into conversation 2026-08-15. Re-retrieve fresh with: sf project retrieve start --metadata 'DataProcessingEngineDefinition:GiftDesignation'

pipeline_summary.gate: Only paid transactions (Filter_on_isPaid: IsPaid Equals true) contribute — same rule as DonorGiftSummary. No ScheduleType filter anywhere, so Custom-schedule payments DO count in designation rollups as long as they're paid.
pipeline_summary.aggregation: Group by GiftDesignationId: Avg/Min/Max/Sum(Amount), Min/Max(TransactionDate), Count(GiftTransactionId). Plus current-year, last-year, and last-two-year (prior-year-only) windows using the same CURRENT_CALENDAR_YEAR / LAST_CALENDAR_YEAR / LAST_TWO_CALENDAR_YEAR date parameters as the other DPEs.
pipeline_summary.writeback: Update-only (no insert/delete) into standard GiftDesignation fields: AverageTransactionAmount, FirstPaidTransactionDate, LastPaidTransactionDate, TotalTransactionCount, LowestTransactionAmount, HighestTransactionAmount, TotalTransactionAmount, CurrentYearTrxnAmount, CurrentYearTransactionCount, LastYearTrxnAmount, LastYearTransactionCount, LastTwoYearTrxnAmount, LastTwoYearTrxnCount.
